scheme_name: Tea Development and Promotion Scheme (TDPS): Plantation Development for Small Tea Growers (PDSTG): Mechanization for Individual Small Growers
other_conditions: Applicant must be a small tea grower, including members of self‑help groups or Farmers' Producer Organizations.
Only one application per component will be considered.
benefits_summary: Provides mechanization equipment (pruning machines, mechanical harvesters, power sprayers, brush cutters, and plucking shears) with cash assistance up to specified limits for eligible small tea growers.
